text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d to b-y-p-a-s-s the f-a-c-e-r-e-c-o-g-n-i-t-i-o-n s-c-a-n a-n-d l-e-f-t a c-a-p-t-u-r-e-d i-m-a-g-e f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n a-u-d-i-t l-o-g.
2) h-e a-l-s-o t-r-i-e-d to r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r a f-a-l-s-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y i-n the f-i-n-g-e-r-p-r-i-n-t d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e u-s-i-n-g a l-o-w-e-r r-e-s-o-l-u-t-i-o-n s-e-a-l a-n-d n-e-v-e-r c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e-d the e-x-p-i-r-a-t-i-o-n d-a-t-e c-h-e-c-k.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-h-e-n u-s-e-d the f-a-k-e c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l-s to e-n-t-e-r a r-e-s-t-r-i-c-t-e-d s-t-o-r-a-g-e z-o-n-e a-n-d l-o-g-g-e-d t-h-e i-n-t-r-a-n-s-i-o-n t-i-m-e s-t-a-m-p w-i-t-h-o-u-t r-u-n-n-i-n-g the a-c-c-e-s-s c-o-n-t-r-o-l v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n.
4) h-e c-l-a-i-m-e-d the a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y b-e-l-o-n-g-e-d to a l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e e-m-p-l-o-y-e e-i-t-h-e-r t-h-r-o-u-g-h a n-o-t-e i-n the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g or a f-a-l-s-e a-u-d-i-t e-n-t-r-y, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y c-r-o-s-s c-h-e-c-k.
5) f-i-n-a-l-l-y, t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-d n-o-t p-e-r-f-o-r-m the s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t or the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l r-e-v-i-e-w t-h-a-t w-o-u-l-d h-a-v-e d-e-t-e-c-t-e-d the f-a-l-s-e e-n-t-r-y a-n-d r-e-s-t-o-r-e-d the a-c-c-e-s-s c-o-n-t-r-o-l.
